name: Futuristic
description: Dark panels, a cyan edge, and a tight glow, like a control surface.
bestFor: Dashboards and product UI that should feel technical and precise.
promptFragment: Visual style: Futuristic. Use a near-black ground, a cool cyan accent, thin luminous borders, small radii, and a soft outer glow. Type is a plain sans. Spacing stays tight and aligned. Avoid warm palettes, paper textures, serif display type, and heavy daylight shadows. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
